facts.fact: BUNEC's Director General says computerisation has been extended to 60 principal civil registration centres, of 432 principal centres (49 of them in diplomatic missions), beside 2,439 secondary and 149 special centres in health facilities; the interview is undated in the document, so the date is its publication date.
BUNEC's Director General says deployment of a national civil status database began in 2022 with a pilot covering civil status registration centres in some councils of Yaounde.

BUNEC's Director General describes a hybrid model in which the paper-based manual process is the dominant one and a parallel digital registration model operates only in selected councils; the statement is undated, so the date is the publication date.

BUNEC, the national civil status registration office, is deploying the national civil status database and leads the reform launched in 2018, working with the World Bank, UNICEF and other UN agencies; date is the publication date.
BUNEC's Director General says a strategic plan with a 2030 objective is being implemented, aiming at full computerisation of civil registration by 2029-2030; date is the publication date.

BUNEC's Director General puts the cost of full digitalisation at a little over FCFA 50 billion (about US$85 million) by 2029-2030, up from a 2018 estimate of FCFA 25 billion, names financing as a primary hurdle and plans a public-private partnership; no budget line is given; date is the publication date.
